title: Create an audience
content_data:
This topic discusses how to create audiences by using [Audience](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739940398505986) API. - Custom Audience
You can create a Custom Audience by [file](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1747012327159809) or [rules](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739566532187138). A minimum audience size of 1,000 is required to target Custom Audiences in an ad group. - Lookalike Audience
You can use an existing audience to [create a Lookalike Audience](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1747012174934018) for retargeting purposes. - Saved Audience
You can [create a Saved Audience](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1780156510696449) and then apply it to your ad groups.
